findings.evidence: Mathlib `RingTheory/Polynomial/Resultant/Basic.lean:952` `discr_of_degree_eq_two : discr f = f.coeff 1 ^ 2 - 4 * f.coeff 0 * f.coeff 2`, giving `(X ^ 2 - C d).discr = 4 * d`. `Splitting.lean:104` concludes `¬ p ∣ exponent θ` under `[NumberField K]`, `hgen : Algebra.adjoin ℚ {(θ : K)} = ⊤` — exactly the hypotheses of `IntegralPrimitiveElement K`. Import chain `Index/Exponent → Index/Discriminant → Index/PowerBasis, Discriminant/OfIntegralBasis` never reaches `Quadratic/`, so no cycle.
findings.fix: Delete `algebraMap_four_mul_mem_conductor` and prove `not_dvd_exponent_of_minpoly_quadratic` as `not_dvd_exponent_of_not_dvd_discr_minpoly ⟨θ, hgen⟩`, computing `(minpoly ℤ θ).discr = 4 * d` from `hmin` via `Polynomial.discr_of_degree_eq_two` and keeping the existing `p ≠ 2`/`p ∤ d` case split (lines 116–123) as the proof of `¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ 4 * d`.
findings.issue: `algebraMap_four_mul_mem_conductor` (lines 59–97) plus the `hdvd` block of `not_dvd_exponent_of_minpoly_quadratic` (lines 101–113) is the `minpoly = X² - C d` special case of the PR's new `not_dvd_exponent_of_not_dvd_discr_minpoly`; the PR leaves the 50-line duplicate in place.

findings.evidence: Both sides are the least positive `n` with `∀ b, (n : 𝓞 K) * b ∈ ℤ[θ]` (`RingOfIntegers.exponent_eq_sInf`, Mathlib `NumberField/Ideal/KummerDedekind.lean:79`, vs `AddMonoid.exponent_eq_sInf`). Mathlib proves the ideal analogue by exactly this identity inline: `Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Int.lean:97–102` (`absNorm_under_eq_sInf`, `← AddMonoid.exponent_eq_sInf`, `AddGroup.exponent_dvd_card`); `Group.exponent_dvd_nat_card` at `Mathlib/GroupTheory/Exponent.lean:532`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem exponent_eq_addMonoidExponent (θ : IntegralPrimitiveElement K) : exponent θ.1 = AddMonoid.exponent θ.Quotient` (dvd_antisymm from `exponent_dvd_iff`, `mem_conductor_iff`, `nsmul_mkQ_eq_zero_iff`, `AddMonoid.exponent_dvd_iff_forall_nsmul_eq_zero` — both halves are already in the current proofs), then derive `exponent_dvd_index` from `AddGroup.exponent_dvd_nat_card` and `dvd_exponent_of_dvd_index` from `exists_prime_addOrderOf_dvd_card` + `AddMonoid.addOrder_dvd_exponent`.
findings.issue: Under-generalized: `exponent_dvd_index` (line 64) and `dvd_exponent_of_dvd_index` (line 71) each re-derive one half of the unconditional identity `exponent θ.1 = AddMonoid.exponent θ.Quotient`, which the PR never states even though it is the natural, primality-free statement of this work.

summary: The new general theorem `not_dvd_exponent_of_not_dvd_discr_minpoly` subsumes the hand-rolled quadratic special case still living in `Quadratic/Splitting.lean`, which should be deleted in this PR; and the file ships only the prime-divisor corollary when the unconditional identity `exponent θ = AddMonoid.exponent (𝓞 K ⧸ ℤ[θ])` is what its two proofs establish.
